Medžuslovjansky

Čitajte polny povezany medžuslovjansky PDF-čitateljnik — latinica · dostati PDF-fajl.

Glavny cělj tutogo izdanja jest praktično čitanje ljudmi, ktori govoret slovjanskymi jezykami, vključajuči čitateljev, ktori ne znajut anglijskogo jezyka. To jest polno zamrznuto medžuslovjansko izdanje v047 korpusa, oprěděljenogo německym avtoritetnym izdanjem NOETH-DE-ED-0011: statje 1–43, lekcijsko dělo 44, statja 45 i bibliografija. Latinica jest jezyčnym iztočnikom; kirilica jest deterministično izvedeny drugy zapis togo samogo teksta, a ne oddělny prěklad.

Citovanje i nyněšnji status. Točny DOI zamrznutoj versije v047 jest 10.5281/zenodo.21926383; stabilny DOI koncepta jest 10.5281/zenodo.21926382. Slědujuča versija jest aktivno redagovana. Pri tutom javnom kontrolnom punktu ostavaje 270 imen, naslovov, měst ili citatnyh izrazov, ktore trěba klasifikovati prěd novym izvedenjem kirilice i polnym sostavjanjem. Te popravky ne sut čestju zamrznutoj v047.

Javna versija sodrživaje polny povezany čitateljnik, redagujeme izvorne fajly, arhiv dokazov i pohođenja i spisok kontrolnyh sum SHA-256. To jest naučno rabotno izdanje, izrabotano s mašinnoju pomočju. Ono ne prošlo vněšnu naučnu recenziju i ne tvrdi potvrđenje rodnymi govoriteljami, medžuslovjanskoju obćinoju, oficialnym standardom ili nezavisnoju institucijeju.

To izdanje imaje odnosenje IsTranslationOf k německomu avtoritetnomu korpusu NOETH-DE-ED-0011 i IsPartOf k globalnomu mnogojezyčnomu korpusu Emmy Noether. Repozitorij: KokunoYumeto/emmy-noether-isv.

English

Read the complete linked Interslavic reader — Latin script · download the PDF.

The primary purpose of this edition is practical reading by people who speak Slavic languages, including readers who do not know English. This is the complete frozen v047 Interslavic edition of the corpus defined by German authority NOETH-DE-ED-0011: Papers 1–43, lecture work 44, Paper 45, and the bibliography. Latin is the linguistic source; Cyrillic is a deterministically derived representation of the same text, not a separate translation.

Citation and current status. The exact DOI for frozen v047 is 10.5281/zenodo.21926383; the stable concept DOI is 10.5281/zenodo.21926382. The next version is under active editorial review. At this public checkpoint, 270 names, titles, places, or citation surfaces still require classification before a new Cyrillic derivation and complete rebuild. Those corrections are not part of frozen v047.

The public record provides the complete linked reader, editable sources, evidence and provenance, and a SHA-256 manifest. This is a machine-assisted scholarly working edition. It has not undergone external scholarly peer review and does not claim certification by native speakers, the Interslavic community, an official standard, or an independent institution.

This edition IsTranslationOf German authority corpus NOETH-DE-ED-0011 and IsPartOf the global multilingual Emmy Noether corpus. Repository: KokunoYumeto/emmy-noether-isv.
